claims.value: Zurich_bow_S40 -> Zurich_bowS40.raw; Zurich_bow_S47 -> Zurich_bowS47.raw; extraction_negative_control -> NegControl.raw
claims.evidence: 3 RAW files in the PRIDE file list (all projectAccessions=PXD001727). Protocol: two bow samples from two areas under two different bark strips plus one negative control. Submitter MaxQuant summaries list Zurich_bowS40/Zurich_bowS47 (bow search) and 20110810_Velos3_JVO_QC_COLLAB_Enrico-NegControl_S73 (control search); RAW-header acquisition names carry the same sample numbers S40, Sample_47, S73.
Two independent physical bow samples (different bark strips) in one condition numbered 1 and 2; the single blank is 1.
PRIDE organisms/sampleAttributes declare Bos taurus and Ovis aries; Bovidae (NCBITaxon:9895) is their lowest common taxon. Inferred; per-sample species not available without the paper.
Protocol: negative control prepared identically 'except for the initial addition of no ancient material'.
Sample is wood flakes with adhesive residue; title says hide glue but the tissue source could not be verified from the paper.
All RAW headers: 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS', instrument VELOS3. Overrides PRIDE field 'Q Exactive' and MaxQuant 'LTQ Orbitrap XL'.
Methods 150min_Top10HCD / JVO_90min_Top10HCD; 'Scan Event 2 repeated for top 10 peaks'.
'Activation Type: HCD' in all RAW headers.
'Normalized Coll. Energy: 40.0' in all RAW headers.
HCD Top10 on LTQ Orbitrap Velos with FT master scan; MaxQuant FTMS MS/MS tolerance used. Inferred from instrument configuration.
Protocol: sequencing grade trypsin (Promega); MaxQuant enzyme Trypsin/P, specific, 2 missed cleavages; 1252 of 1254 bow evidence rows end in K/R.

claims.evidence: No labelling in protocol; MaxQuant multiplicity 1; one RAW file per sample, no fractionation described.
Archaeological glue residue and an extraction blank: no disease state applies. Added after independent review (recommended column).

limitations: Publication (J Archaeol Sci 63:65-71, 2015) could not be read: not in PubMed/Europe PMC, no open-access copy.
Organism Bovidae is inferred as the lowest common taxon of the PRIDE-declared Bos taurus and Ovis aries; per-sample species not established.
Organism part not available: 'hide' in the title is the authors' conclusion and was not verifiable.
RAW-header acquisition names place the bow runs in other batch labels ('Enrico-Parchments_S40', 'Eske_Ancient_Skin_Sample_47'); mapping follows the submitter's renaming and MaxQuant searches.
Negative control acquired 2011-08-10 with a 90 min method versus 2010 and a 150 min method for the bow samples, although the protocol says it was processed together with them.
PRIDE instrument field (Q Exactive) contradicts every RAW header (LTQ Orbitrap Velos).
ExtSearch (per-species reference proteome) result archives were not opened.

No factor value column: species is the study's finding, not a condition, and characteristics[sample type] = study sample / negative control cannot be used because the offline PRIDE cache used by parse_sdrf --use_ols_cache_only (upstream CI) rejects 'study sample' (PRIDE:0001013 is valid in live OLS). The blank is identified by source name and organism 'not applicable'.
